Navigation pill motion

Captured from the final Android implementation on the API 36 emulator. Step through the frames to inspect the regular pill, extended menu and dock, modal actions, and write feedback.

Frozen Compose animation frames, cropped to the pill's part of the screen. Labels ending in 080/160 identify sampled animation-clock positions after the action; repository work and host close delays also use real time. These frames show rendered state and geometry, not physical-phone smoothness or measured frame pacing. All images are embedded; this report makes no network requests.
